_comment: The English catalogue: the French source text as key, its English label as value. Short interface labels only — the long prose of the provenance pages, the cards and the quarterly chronicles lives with its data, in historical-figures.<lang>.json, cards.<lang>.json and front-history.<lang>.json, and falls back to French until an author writes it.
— la main entière est partie ce trimest: — the whole hand went this quarter.
— le défenseur perd la guerre des coûts: — the defender is losing the cost war.
: une facture, retranchée du bilan: : a bill, deducted from the balance sheet
Rapport d'échange : <b>%1 €</b> dépensé: Exchange ratio: €%1 spent on interception per euro destroyed

<b>Aucun secteur</b> n'a bougé ce trimes: No sector moved this quarter, out of %1.
<strong>Déroulé hypothétique.</strong> U: Counterfactual run. An army broke in this run, which did not happen. After %1, the front shown is no longer that of the real war: it is the one the model's balance of forces produces.
<strong>La guerre s'arrête ici.</strong>: The war stops here. This run ends %1 — the %2 following quarters of the calendar were never played.
<strong>Projection.</strong> Après %1, p: Projection. After %1, nothing more is observed. The real position of that quarter serves as the board, and only the eight simulated sectors move it — the rest of the map is left where history left it.

les obus, les drones, les missiles, les: the shells, the drones, the missiles, the interceptors

Plafonné à <b>%1 %</b> du besoin. Tout c: Capped at %1% of the need. Everything produced beyond it, in the other resources, turns into nothing.
Rapports de force <b>calculés par le mod: Balances of forces computed by the model across its eight sectors; the map itself carries the real position of the quarter.
recette pour qui l'exporte, charge nette: revenue for whoever exports it, a net charge for whoever imports it
Un chiffre entre ici quand une observati: A figure enters here when a dated observation supports it, and not before. Every other item on the board is a scenario constant: its page says so, and that is all it has to say.
Un secteur ne bouge qu'au-delà d'un rapp: A sector only moves beyond a ratio of 1.1, and attacking costs three to five times what holding costs. A reading hexagon is 40 km across, about 1,400 km²: nothing finer survives the drawing, and the outlines are approximate, laid down to be read.
